name: Worcester JCC Summer Camps
description_short: Summer day camps at the Worcester JCC building and grounds on Salisbury Street: a preschool program, a general day camp and a sports camp for grades 1 to 9. Campers swim daily in indoor and outdoor pools, take Red Cross swim lessons, and play sports, do crafts and explore nature.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camps and Programs page: Summer Camp 2027 dates and details still to come; links the 2026 Summer Camps and Program Guide and a 2026 financial aid application; preschool summer program, day camp and sports camp; 80,000 square foot facility with indoor and outdoor pools, gym, fields, tennis courts. The 2026 guide link would not open for the fetcher, so no dates or prices are recorded.

Researched by Claude from this page. Day Camp grades 1 to 9: sports, swimming, nature, arts and crafts, Red Cross swim lessons, daily free swim. The Sports Camp page (https://www.worcesterjcc.org/sports-camp/) also says grades 1 to 9; the Preschool Summer Program has 3, 4 and 5 year old classrooms.
